title: Graph height / px
description: Height of the strain plot; clamped to 40–160 px.

title: Skills
description: combined = one silhouette of the summed skill strains. per-skill = the same silhouette split into stacked bands: osu! aim and speed, taiko colour, rhythm and stamina. Catch (movement) and mania (strains) have a single skill.

title: Show time
description: Time axis under the graph and the elapsed / total clock in the header.

title: Show kiai and breaks
description: Marks kiai (amber) and break (hatched) sections. vosu reports them as the map clock passes them, in play and in the song-select preview; each map remembers the sections already seen.
